description.en: Contract drafting, contract review, agreement analysis, clause extraction, obligations, procurement contracts, NDAs, legal risk, breach risk, and payment terms.
description.zh: 合同起草、合同审查、协议分析、条款抽取、义务识别、采购合同、保密协议、法律风险、违约风险和付款条款。

description.en: Regulatory compliance, policy checks, compliance review, legal controls, audit readiness, and regulated operation.
description.zh: 监管合规、政策检查、合规审查、法律控制、审计准备和受监管业务。

description.en: Fraud detection, fraud prevention, scam detection, transaction risk, abuse signals, and suspicious activity analysis.
description.zh: 欺诈检测、欺诈预防、诈骗识别、交易风险、滥用信号和可疑行为分析。

description.en: Data privacy, personal information protection, privacy review, data protection, consent, and sensitive data handling.
description.zh: 数据隐私、个人信息保护、隐私审查、数据保护、授权同意和敏感数据处理。

description.en: Cybersecurity, security audit, vulnerability detection, threat analysis, software security, smart contract security, and penetration testing.
description.zh: 网络安全、安全审计、漏洞检测、威胁分析、软件安全、智能合约安全和渗透测试。

description.en: Software engineering, code generation, code review, developer tools, CI/CD, testing, debugging, and repository automation.
description.zh: 软件工程、代码生成、代码审查、开发者工具、持续集成、测试、调试和仓库自动化。

description.en: Blockchain systems, smart contracts, wallets, decentralized applications, on-chain data, and crypto infrastructure.
description.zh: 区块链系统、智能合约、钱包、去中心化应用、链上数据和加密基础设施。

description.en: Medical technology, clinical tools, diagnosis assistance, medical devices, healthcare AI, and patient-facing medical systems.
description.zh: 医疗技术、临床工具、诊断辅助、医疗设备、医疗人工智能和面向患者的医疗系统。

description.en: Finance, financial analysis, financial planning, accounting, payments, capital markets, and business finance.
description.zh: 金融、财务分析、财务规划、会计、支付、资本市场和企业财务。

description.en: Banking services, bank operations, credit, lending, deposits, and banking customer workflows.
description.zh: 银行服务、银行运营、信贷、贷款、存款和银行客户流程。

description.en: Sports technology, athlete tracking, wearable sports devices, sports data platforms, and performance technology.
description.zh: 体育科技、运动员追踪、运动可穿戴设备、体育数据平台和竞技表现技术。

description.en: Sports analytics, match analysis, player statistics, performance metrics, and team data analysis.
description.zh: 体育分析、比赛分析、球员统计、表现指标和团队数据分析。
